name: crrate-capital-readiness-gateway
description: Explore capital readiness without an account, or connect CRRATE to discuss your released reports.

interface.longDescription: Explore CRRATE without an account: ask capital-readiness questions and use the founder health check. When you want to discuss your own results, connect your CRRATE account so ChatGPT can read your released report and explain priorities, gaps, and next steps. CRRATE does not create or change assessments, scores, reports, credits, payments, or account data in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: What makes a startup capital ready?
Give me a founder health check.
Open my latest CRRATE report and explain what I should strengthen first.

publication.release_notes: Removed promotional pricing language while preserving both V6 pathways: public capital-readiness guidance and authenticated discussion of released reports.
